claims.statement: A settlement in 403 BCE restored Athenian democracy after the rule of the Thirty and the fighting that followed. The Spartan king Pausanias intervened in the reconciliation. Socrates’ trial belongs to this restored democracy, four years later. The two events should not be collapsed into one.
Acropolis reference for Athens, not the exact event location
